runtime_estimate_scope: The9-hour allocation follows a measured-input extrapolation with a2x engineering margin. It is not a proven runtime bound or a promise of convergence. The watchdog enforces actual wall/memory limits.
failure_policy: Complete all five listed cases to diagnose numerical screens unless a resource, source, finite-operator identity or independent-propagator check fails. Failed grid/domain screens are preserved and do not convert software completion into physical success. No automatic finer grid, extra geometry, basin restriction or protein fitting.
physical_scope: All three positive coordinates and the expanded known-minimum margin. Even passing every finite numerical screen does not establish whole-plane tail coverage, a native basin, protein affordability or biological validity.
controlling_screen_rule: Both fixed-domain spacing pairs h=1/2 versus1/4 and h=1/4 versus1/8, and both fixed-spacing domain pairs, are controlling. Every pair must satisfy maximum absolute normalized G0/K/C difference <=0.001 across all ordered nodes and all prescribed times. Three-level error trend is retained as a diagnostic only. No Richardson division, retrospective tolerance relaxation or estimated convergence order changes admission.
prospective_policy_revision: Both consecutive spacing comparisons and both domain comparisons remain required, preserving the v11 reference-admission rule. A briefly saved but unexecuted finest-pair-only variant is explicitly superseded and retained in history/unexecuted-finest-pair-variant-*. No corrected-domain response was computed under that variant. The completed harmonic implementation is the positive first milestone; this later campaign can complete while failing reference admission. A failure requires a separately specified and costed refinement or justified numerical method, not weaker criteria.
